[[File:Goh Pokémon.png|thumb|250px|Some of Goh's Pokémon]]
The following is a '''list of Pokémon currently owned by [[Goh]]'''. As his goal is to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} every {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that he meets on his way to catch {{an|Mew}}, Goh owns a multitude of Pokémon species, most of which he usually keeps at the [[Cerise Laboratory]]. The [[Galar first partner Pokémon]] are the only ones that he permanently keeps in his [[party]].

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Goh left all of his Pokémon, aside from his Galar first partner Pokémon, under [[Professor Cerise]]'s care before departing from the Cerise Laboratory, though he still continues to catch new Pokémon.

==Trivia==
* Goh's:
** {{p|Sentret}} was the first [[Generation II]] Pokémon to be caught by a main character since [[Dawn's Quilava]], who was received as a {{p|Cyndaquil}} in ''[[DP143|An Egg Scramble!]]'', 488 episodes earlier.
*** It is also his first Generation II Pokémon.
** {{p|Tentacool}} was the first {{type|Water}} that isn't a [[first partner Pokémon]] to be caught by a main character other than {{Ash}} on-screen, not counting {{an|Cilan|temporary}} [[BW037|captures]], since [[Dawn's Buizel]], who was caught in ''[[DP034|Buizel Your Way Out Of This!]]'', 593 episodes earlier.
*** It is also his first Water-type.
** White Flower {{p|Floette}} was the first Pokémon to be released by one [[Ash's friends]], excluding Pokémon that were released in the same episode they were caught, since [[Misty's Togetic]], who was released in ''[[AG045|A Togepi Mirage!]]'', 832 episodes earlier.
*** She was also his first released Pokémon.
** {{p|Paras}} and {{p|Parasect}} were the first {{type|Grass}} Pokémon that isn't a first partner Pokémon to be caught on-screen by one of Ash's friends since [[Brock's Ludicolo]], who was caught as a {{p|Lotad}} in ''[[AG012|The Lotad Lowdown]]'', 805 episodes earlier.
*** They are also his first Grass-type.
** {{p|Voltorb}} was the first [[Shiny Pokémon]] to be caught by a main character other than Ash since he caught his {{AP|Noctowl}} in ''[[EP154|Fowl Play!]]'', 1,012 episodes earlier.
** {{p|Sandile}} was the first {{type|Ground}} to be caught by a main character other than Ash since [[Iris's Gible]], who was caught in [[BWS02]], almost six years earlier.
*** It is also the first {{type|Dark}} to be caught by one of Ash's friends on-screen.
*** In addition, it was his first Dark and Ground-type.
** {{p|Nidoran♂}} was the first male-only Pokémon to be caught by a main character other than Ash.
*** He was also his first male-only Pokémon.
** {{p|Nidoran♀}} was his first female-only Pokémon.
** {{p|Binacle}} was his first {{type|Rock}} and [[Generation VI]] Pokémon.
** {{p|Floette}} was his first {{type|Fairy}} Pokémon.
** {{p|Vibrava}} was his first {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon.
** Alolan {{p|Exeggutor}} was his first [[Regional form]] Pokémon.
** {{p|Regieleki}} is the only [[Legendary Pokémon]] residing at [[Cerise Laboratory]]. 
** {{p|Arctozolt}} is the only Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}} to have used the move {{m|Bolt Beak}}.
